difference_from_nearest: SUSCA changes scalar marginal values/support floors inside shared capacity; SCCATF introduces pairwise covariance cross-terms between allocation choices, so the objective is no longer separable across regions.
external_prior_art: Covariance-aware optimal design/allocation is established; 2026 covariance-aware compromise allocation explicitly puts covariance interactions into a constrained allocation objective.
mechanism_removing_comparator: same CATF allocation with covariance coupling removed from the objective
new_failure_mode: CATF allocates with additive local losses while off-diagonal support covariance makes one region choice change the risk cost of another region choice.
non_additive_interaction: SACPS covariance enters CATF as an off-diagonal quadratic cross-term over allocation exposures; strong coupling changes the joint allocation while zero/low coupling collapses to CATF.
